$comment: Per-series harvest lists for the Harvest tab. Checkbox state lives in the per-dinner Firestore doc (state.harvest). Built 2026-07-29 off the 7/24 Kelly call + the August sourcing table. Farm morning-picks: summer squash, sweet peppers, cucumbers, cabbage, tender herbs, edible flowers, squash blossoms, farm berries. Onions for the agrodolce come down to SF ahead (one cook for the whole series). Corn, blackberries and huckleberries are bought-in. Tomatoes are UPSIDE ONLY — the Course 1 plate is complete without them, do not force them. | 2026-08-19: sell blocks added. Every invoiceable item carries sell:{item,qty,unit} — the exact name on Kelly's Remy sheet and HER sell unit, weekend-total qty (null = pick to availability, packed entry fills it). sell:{skip:reason} lines never reach the invoice. Composite rows split per priced item. Validate with validate_harvest.py before publishing a series.

weekends.label: August 8-9
weekends.intro: Only what needs picking fresh at the farm this weekend. Corn and blackberries are bought-in and arrive with the load. The agrodolce onions already came down to SF. Lamb and crab are both handled at the farm — see the confirm list. Sunday repeats Saturday.

items.name: Summer squash
items.qty: about 25 lb for the weekend
items.note: Course 1 both ways — raw ribbons + charred scapece · pick young and firm, nothing seedy · the panelle squash already went into the trays at SF

items.name: Sweet peppers
items.qty: about 4 lb per night — 8 lb for the weekend
items.note: Course 1 · charred on the Egg then marinated — replaced the beans, Kelly has these in volume

items.name: Cucumbers
items.qty: about 8 per night — priced per lb, weigh at pack
items.note: Crab bite vessel · sliced into rounds, pick + chill early, they hold better cold

items.name: Cabbage
items.qty: about 8 heads per night — roughly 20 lb for the weekend
items.note: Course 3 contorni · cut into wedges, grilled, finished in the lamb jus · Kelly holding 50 lb, claim 30-40 for the series

items.note: salmoriglio for the lamb · count the bunches that go in the box

Bought-in and arriving with the load: sweet corn, blackberries. No bread this series — there is no Breadfarm order.
